content.title: 3D Animation Short Generator
content.summary: Develop story, character, and setting into controllable camera work, performance, and continuity. The Seedance companion breaks a longer narrative into connected segments of no more than 15 seconds each.

quick_start.input_format: Story goal + character definitions + setting + shot and performance plan + continuity anchors + connected segments of 15 seconds or less
quick_start.recommended_input: Progress from story, character, and setting to camera, performance, and continuity control; the Seedance companion breaks a long-form sequence into connectable segments of no more than 15 seconds each.
required_anchors: Use the pinned official MiniMax H3 upstream Skill.
Use the independent Seedance 2.0 companion for Seedance.
Do not copy the upstream Skill body or duplicate it into ComfyUI.
usage_steps: Choose the matching official MiniMax H3 Skill and install it from the pinned upstream link.
Prepare only the assets and facts required by that Skill.
Use the independent Seedance companion when targeting Seedance 2.0.
Validate identity, timing, text and asset responsibilities before generation.
applicable_scope: Progress from story, character, and setting to camera, performance, and continuity control; the Seedance companion breaks a long-form sequence into connectable segments of no more than 15 seconds each.
Projects that match the upstream Skill's declared purpose and asset contract.
not_suitable_for: Tasks outside the upstream Skill's declared scope.
Cases that require copying the upstream Skill body into this library or importing it into the T8 ComfyUI node.

creative_dna.usage_scope: Progress from story, character, and setting to camera, performance, and continuity control; the Seedance companion breaks a long-form sequence into connectable segments of no more than 15 seconds each.
creative_dna.source_boundary: MiniMax H3 uses the pinned official upstream Skill. Seedance 2.0 uses the independently authored companion Skill in this library. The upstream Skill body is not copied.
creative_dna.comfyui_boundary: This official entry is not imported into ComfyUI because the target node already includes the official MiniMax capability.

review.method: canonical-source offline English editorial pass with terminology and stable-token validation; title naming editorial pass
